lines.text: Hahaha! Feel that? It's the overwhelming power flowing from my body!
Gaze upon this magnificent electric dinosaur!
A hero is no match for me!
Now I am not just the ultimate villain, but the strongest villain too!
Can you handle this destructive power, Moron? ... 'Cause I still can't.
Mwahaha! Now that I've powered up, I'm practically invincible! ... Not actually invincible, of course.
It's quiet! Are you in awe of my newfound power? ... Wait, did you all go out to eat without me?
I'll be doing some things for the Villain Union until you return!
There are so many new buildings! It might be time for a little villainy!
I demand a hideout be built for the Villain Union! ... But if not, I understand.
I see the Maid Cafe hasn't changed at all! Someday I'll have to make my Villain Omurice again!
I am Drake, leader of the Villain Union and the strongest villain there is! Join the union, Moron!
... There I go again, getting even stronger.
I've gotten even stronger than before?! Just what are my limits?!
Haha... Hahaha! I'm becoming more and more perfect! Rejoice!
Give me more! ... If you don't have anymore, though, that's okay.
Haha! Offering a bribe to a villain? A wise choice!
Are you trying to make me happy to lower my guard?! ... If so, you succeeded.
This has improved my opinion of you a little! ... Just a little. Honest.
Growing attached to a villain, eh? You're dangerous.
Just for you, I'll try not to react whenever you say something embarrassing!
Haha! I'm totally ready.
What is it? You wanna join the Villain Union?
Time for a villainous entrance!
It is finally time to show you what a villain can do!
Stand back and watch!
Time for my Villainous Web to shine again!
The Villain Union's always taking new recruits!
My lightning strikes where it wants!
Rest is important!
Nice and slow... Quickly, you say? Okay.
Haha! I'm ready!
Take this! Special Villainous Web!
Mwahaha! Behold the power of a villain!
Too easy!
Taste my lightning!
Villain strike!
Ugh!
Argh!
Hrngh!
I haven't been defeated! I'm just taking a sec to strategically check the floor!
Heh heh... Surprised? That's just the power of the strongest villain alive! Marvel all you'd like!
